00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000001.title: The letter arrives
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000001.synopsis: A letter from Mara’s missing father sends her back to the island she promised herself she would never visit again.
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000001.notes: Let the opening stay quiet. The letter should feel ordinary until the very last line.

00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000002.title: A map of missing places
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000002.synopsis: Mara finds a second map hidden inside her childhood atlas. Its coastline changes when she looks away.
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000002.notes: The map is a record of memory, not geography. Don’t explain this yet.
